A prison is a facility in which inmates are forcibly confined and denied a variety of freedoms under the authority of their captors. Prisons are commonly used for people charged with crimes. They are usually guarded by jailors and wardens. Following the Second War, the Alliance of Lordaeron built and established internment camps for orcs of the Old Horde. The Elemental Plane is the prison plane constructed by the Titan-forged Keepers where they imprisoned the elementals. Mardum is a prison world that was created by Sargeras prior to his becoming the Fallen Titan to hold all the demons he killed in the Great Dark Beyond. The primary command to make a member of a party (or group) the new leader used by the current party leader. The target of the leader promote cannot block the promotion. Ways to promote to leader: * Select a party member character, right-click their portrait and select Promote to Leader. The crown icon () should appear by the portrait of the new leader. Also see Invite and Uninvite.

Profession trainers are NPCs who begin or continue your training in a Profession and teach you various recipes for your profession. These recipes are learned at various intervals, but are usually learned every 5 skillups. When using the tracking system with the minimap they will appear with a brown book () at their locations. See Primary Profession Trainers and Secondary Profession Trainers for lists of profession trainers by type.

Proficiency is a type of skill that allows the use of certain armor and weapon types, depending on a character's class. Most proficiencies are acquired at character creation, while some are learned from a weapon trainer or from Specialization selection. Each class/skill combination is marked with an icon representing how that class gains access to the skill as well as any level requirements. Refer to the legend below for explanations of each icon. Khazgorm and those under his command used explosives to blast holes in the ground despite the protests of the tauren who were living there; eventually Khazgorm ordered his soldiers to attack the tauren and drive them away so the dwarves could have the land to themselves. During the rout, many of the tauren were killed by the dwarves. Prologue was originally an exclusive comic, which was available for free during BlizzCon 2007 at the DC booth on August 3, 2007 and premiered later in November at MTV's Multiplayer blog. It marked the start of the World of Warcraft comic storyline which continued with Stranger in a Strange Land. When Rehgar Earthfury's greatest gladiator, Bloodeye Redfist, is killed, he prepares to track down a new competitor for "The Crimson Ring", an underground network revolving around gladiatorial death matches. Meanwhile, the surviving members of Bloodeye's team, Valeera Sanguinar and Broll Bearmantle, discuss Rehgar's background as a warrior and gladiator.

Profession equipment is a type of item that can be placed in a slot within a profession's interface window. Profession equipment includes traditional tools like blacksmith hammers, as well as items in the Dragon Isles that grant profession bonuses, such as new crafting and gathering stats. Most professions have three equipment slots: one for a tool, and two for accessories. Items placed in the profession equipment slots always count as equipped; notably, this means that fishing poles no longer need to be placed in the main hand slot to use them. Most pieces of profession equipment will show on your character when you perform a profession-related action, and remain until you enter combat. Mah
